subject: Trading
title: Why Most Forex Traders Lose
description: A quick win: understand Why Most Forex Traders Lose.

hook.text: Broker disclosures reveal the truth: 70-80% of retail forex accounts lose money. Consistently, everywhere.

buildup.text: Excessive leverage, overtrading, poor risk management, and emotional decisions are the usual culprits.

discovery.text: The spread, swaps, and commissions create a negative expected value. You must overcome that drag just to break even.

twist.text: Many losing traders have good entry signals. They fail at exits—cutting winners too early and holding losers too long.

climax.text: Forex isn't inherently unprofitable. But the combination of leverage, costs, and psychology defeats most participants.

punchline.text: The market doesn't beat you. You beat yourself.

quiz.question: What is the biggest reason most retail forex traders lose money?
options: Excessive leverage combined with poor risk management and emotions
Spreads are too wide to ever profit
